business_summary: The Waterbase Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an aquaculture company in India and internationally. The company operates through Shrimp Feeds, Processed Shrimp, and Others segments. It offers shrimp feed, such as stimulant vannamei, advanced nutrition shrimp, nutrition-rich monodon, and polyculture feeds under BayWhite advanced, VanaMax, Tiger XL, and Godavari brands. The company also provides farmcare products such as nutripond, VC9, prolyf, uniQPS, PSB9; feed supplements includes nutrifeast, nutri gut, aminovita, WHITEKURE, baybond, immuguard, enrich C, and whispokyn; minerals such as seamin and baymin; absorbents comprise zeolyf, oxylyf, and nutrisorb; and sanitizers such as pond guard and baysoft under Baylife brand. In addition, engages in shrimp farming and hatchery activities; provides frozen shrimp and seafood; processing and exports products such as vannamei and black tiger shrimps, which includes blocj frozen, VDP block frozen, butterfly, head less shell on, head on shell on, peeled and deveined tail off and on, and skewers; and operates aqua diagnostic centers. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Chennai, India. The Waterbase Limited operates as a subsidiary of Aquavista Enterprises Private Limited.
